Average the probes that measure one CpG

Source: R/methylationTrack_helpers.R
INTERNAL_meth_query.Rd

The mean of each CpG's values, skipping missing ones, as sesame::betasCollapseToPfx() does for replicate probes. Here the replicates are those at one position, so probes with different IDs are averaged too, and replicates at different positions are not.

A row in an array's own matrix shows the array has the CpG. In a matrix merged across arrays there are no such rows to go on, so any value from one of the array's samples shows it.

Only here are the arrays joined, and only for the CpGs of this region.

Where arrays disagree over a CpG, the first array's value stands.

By the span of a transcript, so one with only an intron in the region is kept.

Usage

.meth_collapse(betas, pos)

.meth_array_region(a, reg)

.meth_coverage(hits, pos, betas, table, merged = FALSE)

.meth_query(cohort, region, samples = NULL, scope = "all", max.cpgs = 1000)

.meth_join_rowdata(hits, pos)

.meth_region_txns(cohort, reg, region)

.meth_region_bands(cohort, chr)

Arguments

betas

The joined matrix, CpGs in rows, over all the cohort's samples.

pos

The positions, in order.

a

An array of a methylationCohort.

reg

The region as a GRanges.

hits

The regions from .meth_array_region().

table

The cohort's sample table.

merged

Logical; whether the cohort is one matrix merged across arrays.

cohort

A methylationCohort.

region

The region, from .meth_region().

samples

The names of the samples to keep, or NULL for all.

scope

"all" for every CpG on any plotted array, "shared" for those on all of them.

max.cpgs

The most CpGs to draw. A larger region is an error, as in sesame::visualizeRegion().

chr

A chromosome.

Value

A matrix with one row per position, in position order.

A list of pos, betas, probes and rowdata, one row per position, or NULL where the array has nothing there.

A logical matrix with a column per platform, or NULL where the cohort names no platforms.

A list of region, betas (CpGs in rows), absent (cells whose array lacks the CpG), coverage, cpgs, rowdata, samples, txns and cytobands.

A data frame with one row per position.

A GRangesList, or NULL.

A data frame, or NULL where there are none.
